title: Inner block in check_and_consume has no comment explaining borrow scope
description: In both admin.rs files, check_and_consume uses an inner block: 'let allowed; { let entry = ...; ... allowed = ...; }'. The block is necessary to drop the mutable borrow of 'entry' before 'state.retain()', but there's no comment saying so. A well-intentioned contributor refactoring this will remove the block, get a borrow-check error, not understand why, and either fight the compiler or work around it incorrectly. Fix: add a one-line comment: '// Drop `entry` borrow before state.retain() needs &mut state.'
